text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky takes the Satsuki Sho! Seiun Sky 
goes wire-to-wire!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Shaking off the fierce pursuit of Special 
Week and King Halo, dubbed the Big Three!! 
She captures the first crown of the Triple 
Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haa, hic... haa... Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Sei-chan was so strong...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't catch up. They were so far 
away. I couldn't even bring myself to say 
I was just one step away.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I was given the chance to run 
in the Satsuki Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (After all that—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Tsuyoshi, we're right behind you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Tsuyoshi, we're right behind you."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: …………I wanted... to win... so baaad~~...!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san. I've checked with the staff 
and received permission. I'll administer 
an IV drip now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hai-eee~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi collapses into the 
chair, her personal doctor connects an IV 
line prepared for her arm.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... Trainer, Teacher. I'm~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"She is visibly exhausted. To think she'd 
fall asleep this quickly."
choice_data_list:
...It was down to the wire during the 
race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even while watching the race, I was 
crushed by that reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fastest Umamusume wins the Satsuki 
Sho. That refers not just to raw speed, 
but also to their "rate of growth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the data of every Umamusume who 
ran, it wasn't as if Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's 
raw talent was inferior.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's 
constitution―― she wasn't able to do the 
training needed to grow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there is nothing physically wrong with 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had more stamina. If only I 
could push harder and sharpen my burst of 
speed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only the circumstances allowed 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi to focus more on 
running—if only she could—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only her own body hadn't gotten in the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The result should have been different.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...You're wondering if there was anything 
else you could have done, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. If only I could have 
prevented more... If only I knew 
treatments that wouldn't hinder an 
athlete's career...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...However, all we can do is keep fighting 
on with what we currently have in our 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Japanese Derby' is 2,400 meters. 
That's a full 400 meters longer than 
today."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, she will face a burden 
far greater than today's.
choice_data_list: Even so, I want to make her win.
Even so, I still want to help her win.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I understand. Shall we begin our 
strategy meeting for that?
choice_data_list:
Yes. Let's go outside so we don't wake 
Tsuyoshi—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squeeeak... slam)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
